description: This is an extract of Nigeria's national Health Facility Registry, the master list of hospitals and clinics kept by the Federal Ministry of Health. The producer is the Federal Ministry of Health, which made the data public on the registry website; it was published on the Humanitarian Data Exchange in September 2021. Coverage is national, with about 42,000 facilities in every state. Each facility has its state, local government area and ward, a unique code and registration number, start date, public or private ownership, level of care (primary, secondary or tertiary), coordinates, and whether it is operational, registered and licensed, with record creation and update dates. The file is available as a free XLSX download with HXL tags under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: it is a 2021 snapshot, coordinates and statuses are as reported by facilities and states, and bed counts and services are not included. Simulation uses: a national health facility layer for hazard exposure, travel-time and referral models, and planning emergency medical coverage by level of care. Related records: healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) offers an open alternative from OpenStreetMap, and the HeiGIT accessibility indicators (data-heigit-accessibility-indicators) summarise access to hospitals.
